personality_one_liner: An authentic, lightning-fast native food ordering experience for DSB Fast Food in Shankar Nagar, Raipur, combining iOS-grade clean surfaces with appetite-driven photography.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm with compact touch padding, strict 8pt grid alignment, and sticky CTA clearance.

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom tab bar over scrolling lists
Apply translucent tinted glass on hero category overlays
dont's: Never blur form fields or dense card interiors
Avoid glass overlays without solid tinted fallback on low-end Android

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase restaurant open/closed status, dynamic delivery estimate, quick category chips, and top hero dishes.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner with amber tint
states.empty: No items available illustration with reload action
states.error: Banner with readable server message and retry button

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with GPS location picker & language toggle, restaurant open/closed badge, search bar with category pills (Noodles, Rice, Starters, Drinks), featured top-seller cards with gradient image scrims, and quick reorder section.

screens.name: Menu
screens.purpose: Comprehensive categorization of Noodles, Rice, Starters, and Drinks with live inventory sold-out badges.

states.loading: Skeleton card loader for menu grid
states.empty: No menu items found for category
states.error: Failed to fetch menu from backend with retry

screens.layout: Segmented category selector bar at top, searchable list/grid of items with price, description, sold-out indicator, and instant quantity stepper adding to cart.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review cart items, apply coupons (e.g. DSB50), calculate delivery fees and total with sticky checkout action.

states.empty: Hungry? Add delicious noodles or starters from the menu to get started with primary browse CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable list of cart items with increment/decrement steppers, coupon code input field with apply/remove toggle, bill breakdown summary (subtotal, delivery fee ₹10, min order ₹50 check), and sticky bottom checkout container.

screens.name: Orders
screens.purpose: Track live order status (Order Received -> Preparing -> Ready -> Completed) and view complete order history.

states.empty: No past orders yet. Place your first order to track it live!

screens.layout: Segmented tab for Active vs Past orders, live status tracker stepper with progress bar, WhatsApp support quick-connect button (9321611315), and order details modal.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage customer phone verification, saved delivery addresses, language preferences, and rating reviews.
screens.layout: Phone number display with OTP verification status, saved delivery address GPS/manual card, English/Hindi language switcher, restaurant hours info (11 AM–11 PM), and support links.

hero_noodles.alt: Delicious stir-fried noodles with vegetable garnish

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-quality cross-platform React Native Expo TypeScript app for DSB Fast Food, Shankar Nagar, Raipur.
Implement the 5 tabs: Home, Menu, Cart, Orders, Profile using Expo Router bottom tabs.

Ensure complete backend API integration with GET /api/items, POST /api/orders/coupon/validate, POST /api/otp/send, POST /api/otp/verify, POST /api/orders, GET /api/orders/by-phone/:phone, GET /api/orders/:id, PATCH /api/orders/:id/delivery-confirm, PATCH /api/orders/:id/rating.
Support live inventory soldOut status, minimum order ₹50, delivery charge ₹10, restaurant hours 11 AM-11 PM dynamic status, and WhatsApp 9321611315.
Incorporate English and Hindi language switching with local persistence via AsyncStorage.
Strictly adhere to iOS-Native Clean palette (#FDFBF7 surface, #C2410C brand primary, warm sand tones, no banned blues/purples).
Ensure all image cards include a gradient-to-dark scrim for pristine text readability.
